subagent_notes: Both callers (WF-25 and WF-11) use mappingMode passthrough with no explicit set_assignments, so dead_pass and caller_missing_required rules are suppressed per schema spec. The output contract (logged, logId) is the response from WF-51 passed back through WF-46 — WF-46 itself emits no explicit output fields, but runtime confirms WF-51's response surfaces to callers. The `channelId` fallback to `user.slack_channel_id` means the field is optional at the contract boundary; WF-46 handles absent channelId gracefully via the Code node.
